english.title: Public service vehicles - passenger failing to pay fare
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a passenger on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), used for the carriage of persons at separate fares and operated by a driver without a conductor failed immediately on boarding to pay the fare for the journey you intended to take

(A)_[to the driver]_
(B)_[by inserting the appropriate money or token in the fare collection equipment provided]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(2)(b)(i) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25 of the Public Passengers Vehicles Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a passenger on a vehicle
used for carriage of persons at separate fares
operated by driver without a conductor
failed immediately on boarding to pay driver OR insert appropriate money or token into collection equipment
fare for intended journey

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 7(2)(b) applies also to a non payment of a fare demanded by a conductor, inspector or driver.
(ii) See section 68(1) of the Passenger Vehicles Act 1981 for defence.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
